searchText: do we ever see ourselves moving to a slot duriation like 9500ms? If so, I would suggest that we add timestamp_ms to the header with shorter slots. I don’t think we’d do fractions of a second for the next few decreases, imo. I feel this is a bridge to cross when we get there rather? Would put my money on not doing fractional until we’re closer to the 4-5s range
